analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a paragraph after line 251 in the head. The paragraph says SSD staging runs before engine.submit, off the engine queue, and that provider-staged complete-checkpoint imports create destinations already available from host bytes. It says they never evaluate or fence those destinations, so staging does not wait on MLX-Swift's process-wide evalLock while another request's prefill chunk runs. The change is documentation only, with no code, config, crypto, authorization or wire-contract change in this diff. It touches the encrypted SSD prefix-cache path (T-041, TB-007, A-001) only descriptively. The described behavior is an availability/latency improvement: staging no longer blocks on the evalLock. The text does not change the at-rest posture: HMAC-keyed names, AES-GCM, sliding TTL, account scoping and the SEC-035 accepted risk are untouched. The behavior depends on CompleteCheckpointTransfer.swift (CBv2CompleteCheckpointImport) and on ../reference/ssd-kv-cache.md. Neither file is in the supplied evidence, so the claim is unverified. A source or integration pass should confirm that host-byte-backed destinations do not skip validation, authentication or reservation release, and that the SSDPrefixCache staging release paths (endAdoption/completeStaging) are unchanged. No finding is raised because the diff alone gives no evidence of a regression. The TB-011/TB-002 coordinator and attestation boundaries are not affected.
